name: Kloosterman Rank-15 K3
curve_family_name: Kloosterman explicit elliptic K3, rank 15 over Q(t)
description: Kloosterman's explicit elliptic K3 surface from Theorem 1.2, proved to have Mordell-Weil rank exactly 15 over Q(t). Rank Hunter preserves that theorem as literature provenance only because this package does not bundle an explicit 15-section basis or a plugin-local exact generic certificate.

provenance.author: Remke Kloosterman
provenance.paper: Elliptic K3 Surfaces with Geometric Mordell-Weil Rank 15
provenance.published_claim: Theorem 1.2 proves that this explicit elliptic K3 surface over Q has Mordell-Weil rank exactly 15 over Q(t).
provenance.abstract_surface_distinction: The paper abstract highlights a different explicit surface with geometric Mordell-Weil rank 15; this plugin implements the Q-rational Theorem 1.2 surface.
provenance.proof_boundary: Kloosterman proves exact rank 15 by combining a rank-at-least-15 construction with an upper bound on the Picard number using reductions at two good primes and the Artin-Tate discriminant comparison.
provenance.release_claim_boundary: Rank Hunter records only historical_generic_rank_lower=15 and historical_record operational state because the plugin does not bundle the 15 generic sections or a current-core generic-rank certificate. No specialization lower bound is inherited from the theorem.
